TWAP and VWAP Execution Mechanics

TWAP

Equal quantities in equal time.

Risk Factor: Front-Running

Without Poisson-ish randomization, a TWAP operating
as a 60-second metronome will be exploited.

Safety Profile

Fails gracefully with guaranteed completion.

VWAP

Forecasts fraction of daily volume (w;).

Risk Factor: Forecast Dependency

Converts execution risk directly into
volume-forecast risk.

Stale schedules ruthlessly eat the difference during
unscheduled news events.

POV Pathology 3: The Never-Finishing Tail

Without an internal clock, a pure POV sits and waits if volume evaporates. To meet deadlines, production
algorithms rely on a catch-up mode, transforming into a frantic sprint with massive marginal costs.

The Meta-Rules of Execution

Evaluate Tails,
Not Just Means.

A scheduler is a bet on a volume
forecast. You cannot evaluate bets
by their average payout while
ignoring blowups. As seen in the
data, massive final-quartile execution
costs prove that averages lie.

Scoreboards Run
on Money.

VWAP slippage measures schedule
adherence, not execution cost.
Keep it strictly as a diagnostic of
scheduling skill. Always grade
actual portfolio impact on
Implementation Shortfall (Arrival
Price).
